% Checks cases that a fix of references to appendix chapters must not
% break: the appendix package's subappendices environment in a report
% with hyperref.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{appendix}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\chapter{Main}\label{main}
Ref: \ref{s:p}; \ref{s:q}; \ref{main}.
\begin{subappendices}
\section{Proof}\label{s:p}
Text of the proof.
\end{subappendices}
\chapter{Next}
\begin{subappendices}
\section{Other proof}\label{s:q}
Text of the other proof.
\end{subappendices}
\end{document}
